scenarios.title: Valid CANBus to CANFrame Reference Resolution
scenarios.description: Verify that a CANBus instance defined in the flync_4_bus submodel successfully configures its frames field with a valid inline CANFrame instance from the flync_4_signal submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the reference resolves correctly, confirming that the CANBus.frames field is populated with a valid CANFrame instance without any cross-module resolution errors.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of CANBus State Membership Reference
scenarios.description: Configure a valid CANBus instance in the flync_4_bus submodel with its state_memberships field referencing a valid StateMembershipRef instance in the flync_4_nm submodel, establishing a valid network management state group association.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the state_memberships reference on the CANBus resolves correctly to the target StateMembershipRef.

scenarios.title: Valid Cross-Module Reference from FLYNCChannelConfig to StandardPDU
scenarios.description: Configure a valid cross-module relationship where a FLYNCChannelConfig instance in the flync_4_communication submodel defines a 'pdus' field that correctly references a valid StandardPDU instance defined in the flync_4_signal submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the reference from FLYNCChannelConfig.pdus to the StandardPDU instance resolves correctly across the submodel boundary.

scenarios.title: Dangling Reference from FLYNCChannelConfig pdus to Non-Existent StandardPDU
scenarios.description: Verify that the FLYNC network configuration validator flags an error when a FLYNCChannelConfig instance contains a reference in its pdus field to a StandardPDU identifier that does not exist in the flync_4_signal configuration.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validation fails, raising a dangling or unresolved reference error indicating that the StandardPDU 'PDU_Chassis_Stat' referenced by FLYNCChannelConfig.pdus cannot be resolved.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the flync_4_communication configuration, a FLYNCChannelConfig instance is defined with a PDU reference 'PDU_Chassis_Stat' in its pdus list. However, the corresponding StandardPDU definition with the identifier 'PDU_Chassis_Stat' is completely omitted from the flync_4_signal configuration.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of CANBus Reference in FLYNCChannelConfig
scenarios.description: Configure a valid FLYNCChannelConfig in the flync_4_communication submodel with its can_buses field referencing a properly defined CANBus instance in the flync_4_bus submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the reference from FLYNCChannelConfig.can_buses to the CANBus instance resolves correctly.

scenarios.title: Valid TCP Profile Reference Resolution
scenarios.description: Verify that FLYNCCommunicationConfig in the flync_4_communication submodel can successfully configure its tcp_profiles field to reference a valid TCPOption instance defined in the flync_4_ecu submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the tcp_profiles reference in FLYNCCommunicationConfig resolves correctly to the defined TCPOption instance.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of SOME/IP Configuration Reference in Communication Config
scenarios.description: Configure a valid FLYNCCommunicationConfig instance in the flync_4_communication module, ensuring its someip_config field is populated with a valid reference to a fully defined SOMEIPConfig instance from the flync_4_someip module.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validation succeeds because the cross-module reference from FLYNCCommunicationConfig.someip_config to the SOMEIPConfig instance resolves correctly.

scenarios.title: Dangling Reference from FLYNCCommunicationConfig to Missing SOMEIPConfig
scenarios.description: Verify that the network configuration validation fails when FLYNCCommunicationConfig has its someip_config field configured to reference a SOMEIPConfig identifier, but that referenced SOMEIPConfig instance is completely absent from the flync_4_someip configuration.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validation fails, raising a validation error indicating a dangling or unresolved reference to the missing SOMEIPConfig identifier 'missing_someip_profile_id'.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the flync_4_communication configuration, FLYNCCommunicationConfig.someip_config is set to 'missing_someip_profile_id', but no SOMEIPConfig instance with that identifier is defined within the flync_4_someip configuration.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of State Management Reference in Communication Configuration
scenarios.description: Configure a valid FLYNCCommunicationConfig instance in the flync_4_communication submodel where the state_management field correctly references and resolves to a fully defined StateManagementConfig instance in the flync_4_nm submodel, including valid StateManagementGroup and timing profiles.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the state_management reference in FLYNCCommunicationConfig resolves correctly to the valid StateManagementConfig instance without any integrity or cross-module linkage errors.

scenarios.title: Dangling Reference from FLYNCCommunicationConfig to Absent StateManagementConfig
scenarios.description: Verify that the configuration validation engine correctly identifies and rejects a dangling cross-module reference when FLYNCCommunicationConfig.state_management is configured to point to a StateManagementConfig identifier, but that referenced StateManagementConfig instance is completely absent from the flync_4_nm configuration.
scenarios.expected_result: The validation process fails, raising a dangling or unresolved reference error indicating that the StateManagementConfig identifier 'non_existent_nm_state_group' referenced by FLYNCCommunicationConfig.state_management does not exist in the flync_4_nm submodel.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the communication configuration, set the FLYNCCommunicationConfig.state_management field to reference a StateManagementConfig with the identifier 'non_existent_nm_state_group', while ensuring that no StateManagementConfig with this identifier is defined anywhere in the flync_4_nm configuration (e.g., in communication/state_management/groups.flync.yaml).

scenarios.title: Valid Controller to EmbeddedMetadata Reference Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify that a Controller instance in the flync_4_ecu submodel is successfully instantiated and validated when its controller_metadata field is configured with a valid EmbeddedMetadata instance from the flync_4_metadata submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the reference from Controller.controller_metadata resolves correctly to the defined EmbeddedMetadata instance.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of Controller App Bindings
scenarios.description: Verify that a Controller configuration in the flync_4_ecu submodel successfully references a valid AppBindings instance in the flync_4_app submodel using the app_bindings field.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the app_bindings reference in the Controller resolves correctly to the corresponding AppBindings instance.

scenarios.title: Valid Controller State Membership Reference
scenarios.description: Configure a Controller in the flync_4_ecu submodel with a state_memberships field that correctly references a valid StateMembershipRef instance in the flync_4_nm submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the state_memberships reference on the Controller resolves correctly to the defined StateMembershipRef.

scenarios.title: Valid DeploymentUnion Root Reference to PDUForwarder
scenarios.description: Configure a DeploymentUnion instance in the flync_4_ecu submodel where its root field correctly references a validly defined PDUForwarder instance in the flync_4_signal submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the cross-module reference from DeploymentUnion.root to the PDUForwarder instance resolves correctly.

scenarios.title: Dangling Reference from DeploymentUnion root to Non-Existent PDUForwarder
scenarios.description: Verify that the configuration validation fails when a DeploymentUnion's root field references a PDUForwarder identifier that is completely absent from the flync_4_signal configuration.
scenarios.expected_result: The system validation fails, raising a dangling reference or unresolved reference error indicating that the PDUForwarder 'pdu_fwd_nonexistent' referenced by DeploymentUnion.root cannot be found.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the flync_4_ecu configuration, a DeploymentUnion instance has its root field set to 'pdu_fwd_nonexistent'. However, no PDUForwarder instance with the identifier 'pdu_fwd_nonexistent' is defined in the flync_4_signal configuration.

scenarios.title: Successful Cross-Module Reference from DeploymentUnion to SOMEIPSDDeployment
scenarios.description: Verify that a DeploymentUnion instance in the flync_4_ecu submodel is successfully validated when its root field correctly references a valid, pre-defined SOMEIPSDDeployment instance in the flync_4_someip submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the cross-module reference from DeploymentUnion.root to the SOMEIPSDDeployment instance resolves correctly.

scenarios.title: Valid Cross-Module Reference from SwitchPort to PTPConfig
scenarios.description: Configure a SwitchPort in the flync_4_ecu submodel with a valid ptp_config field that references a correctly defined PTPConfig instance in the flync_4_tsn submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the SwitchPort.ptp_config reference resolves correctly to the valid PTPConfig instance.

scenarios.title: Valid SwitchPort MACsec Configuration Reference
scenarios.description: Configure a valid SwitchPort in the flync_4_ecu submodel with its macsec_config field referencing a valid MACsecConfig instance defined in the flync_4_security submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the reference from SwitchPort.macsec_config to the MACsecConfig instance resolves correctly.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of FirewallRule Pattern to FrameFilter
scenarios.description: Configure a valid network configuration where a FirewallRule instance in the flync_4_security submodel defines its pattern field to reference a valid FrameFilter instance defined in the flync_4_tsn submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the pattern reference in FirewallRule resolves correctly to the defined FrameFilter instance across the submodules.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of SOMEIPField notifier_e2e to E2EConfig
scenarios.description: Verify that a SOMEIPField defined in the flync_4_someip submodel can successfully reference a valid E2EConfig instance defined in the flync_4_safety submodel via its notifier_e2e field.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the notifier_e2e reference in SOMEIPField resolves correctly to the valid E2EConfig instance.

scenarios.title: Successful Resolution of SOMEIPServiceInterface Meta Reference
scenarios.description: Configure a valid SOMEIPServiceInterface in the flync_4_someip submodel where the meta field correctly references a valid SOMEIPServiceMetadata instance defined in the flync_4_metadata submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the meta reference in SOMEIPServiceInterface resolves correctly to the defined SOMEIPServiceMetadata instance.

scenarios.title: Successful resolution of ExternalConnection _ecu1_port to ECUPort
scenarios.description: Configure a valid network topology where an ExternalConnection instance in the flync_4_topology submodel defines its _ecu1_port field to reference a valid ECUPort instance defined in the flync_4_ecu submodel.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation succeeds because the _ecu1_port reference in ExternalConnection correctly resolves to the defined ECUPort instance.

scenarios.title: Direct Reference from App Service Consumer to Physical CAN Bus
scenarios.description: An application configuration (App class in flync_4_app) attempts to establish a direct dependency on a physical CAN bus configuration (flync_4_bus) by setting its ServiceConsumerReference to point directly to a CAN bus instance instead of an abstract service/transport layer interface.
scenarios.expected_result: The FLYNC model validator must reject the configuration with a validation error, indicating an invalid cross-domain reference and confirming that flync_4_app classes cannot directly reference or depend on physical network elements from flync_4_bus.
scenarios.injected_fault: In apps/application1.flync.yaml, a ServiceConsumerReference is configured with a direct reference to a physical CAN bus named 'CAN_HS_1' (defined in communication/channels/can/can_hs_1.flync.yaml), bypassing the service-oriented abstraction layer entirely.

scenarios.title: Direct Reference from ServiceConsumerReference to FLYNCChannelConfig
scenarios.description: Verifies that the system rejects a configuration where a ServiceConsumerReference in the flync_4_app domain directly references a FLYNCChannelConfig in the flync_4_communication domain, violating the strict architectural isolation between the application layer and the communication layer.
scenarios.expected_result: The model validation fails with a strict schema or deserialization error, rejecting the configuration due to an unrecognized property in ServiceConsumerReference and preventing the cross-domain isolation breach.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the application configuration file (e.g., apps/application1.flync.yaml), a ServiceConsumerReference instance is configured with an illegitimate direct reference field 'communication_channel_ref' pointing directly to a FLYNCChannelConfig instance defined under communication/channels/.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure on Direct Isolation-Breaching Reference between App and SystemMetadata
scenarios.description: Verify that the FLYNC parser and validator reject an application configuration where an App instance (from flync_4_app) contains a direct reference or dependency attribute pointing to a SystemMetadata instance (from flync_4_metadata), violating the architectural isolation between the application layer and the system metadata layer.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validator must fail with a validation error (such as a ValidationError or SchemaError), explicitly stating that the 'App' class does not support direct references to 'SystemMetadata' and rejecting the isolation-breaching cross-domain link.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the application configuration file 'apps/application1.flync.yaml', inject a direct 'system_metadata_ref' field into the App class instance, mapping it directly to the 'SystemMetadata' identifier defined in 'system_metadata.flync.yaml' instead of routing through the standard ECU Controller app_bindings.

scenarios.title: Invalid Direct Reference from App to StateManagementGroup
scenarios.description: An App configuration in flync_4_app attempts to establish a direct dependency or reference to a StateManagementGroup from flync_4_nm. Since these two domains are architecturally isolated, no class in flync_4_app (such as App or ServiceConsumerReference) should ever reference a class in flync_4_nm (such as StateManagementGroup).
scenarios.expected_result: The FLYNC model validator fails with a schema validation or reference resolution error, rejecting the configuration due to an invalid cross-domain reference between App and StateManagementGroup.
scenarios.injected_fault: In apps/application1.flync.yaml, a ServiceConsumerReference within the App configuration is modified to directly reference a StateManagementGroup ID (e.g., 'nm_group_body_domain') instead of a valid service provider.

scenarios.title: Enforce Architectural Isolation Between App Layer and Safety Submodel
scenarios.description: Verify that the model validator rejects configurations attempting to establish a direct link between flync_4_app.App and flync_4_safety.SafetyRequirement. Since these submodels are architecturally isolated, no direct references or dependencies should exist between their respective classes.
scenarios.expected_result: The validation engine fails with a validation error, explicitly rejecting the unauthorized cross-domain reference and enforcing the strict isolation between flync_4_app and flync_4_safety.
scenarios.injected_fault: A configuration is written in apps/application1.flync.yaml where a flync_4_app.App instance directly references a flync_4_safety.SafetyRequirement instance via an unauthorized 'safety_requirement_ref' property.

scenarios.title: Illegal Direct Reference from FirewallRule to ServiceProviderReference
scenarios.description: This scenario tests the strict architectural isolation between the application layer (flync_4_app) and the security layer (flync_4_security). It attempts to establish an illegal direct link by configuring a FirewallRule from flync_4_security to directly reference a ServiceProviderReference from flync_4_app as its traffic target, bypassing the network abstraction layer entirely.
scenarios.expected_result: The model validator fails to parse or validate the configuration, throwing a reference resolution or schema validation error, confirming that no direct relationships or dependencies are permitted between classes in flync_4_app and flync_4_security.
scenarios.injected_fault: A configuration is loaded where a FirewallRule class instance in the firewall configuration contains a direct YAML reference (anchored or path-based) to a ServiceProviderReference class instance defined inside an App configuration file.

scenarios.title: App Layer Direct Reference to Signal Layer Component
scenarios.description: An application configuration attempts to bypass the service and transport abstraction layers by establishing an illegitimate direct reference between a ServiceProviderReference (from the flync_4_app domain) and a SignalInstance (from the flync_4_signal domain), violating the strict architectural isolation between the application and signal layers.
scenarios.expected_result: The model validator fails with a ValidationError, rejecting the configuration due to an unrecognized property 'signal_ref' in the App schema and enforcing the architectural boundary that prevents direct dependencies between the flync_4_app and flync_4_signal domains.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the YAML configuration for an App, a ServiceProviderReference is defined with an unauthorized 'signal_ref' property that directly references the identifier of a SignalInstance from the signal configuration, bypassing the required service-to-PDU mapping.

scenarios.title: Invalid Direct Reference from App ServiceProviderReference to SOME/IP SDTimings
scenarios.description: An illegitimate direct reference is established between flync.model.flync_4_app.ServiceProviderReference in the application domain and flync.model.flync_4_someip.SDTimings in the SOME/IP communication domain, violating the strict architectural isolation between these two submodels.
scenarios.expected_result: The FLYNC model validator fails to parse the configuration, throwing a strict schema validation error or an unresolved reference exception, successfully rejecting the illegitimate cross-domain reference between the application layer and the SOME/IP configuration layer.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the apps/application1.flync.yaml configuration file, a ServiceProviderReference instance is injected with a direct 'sd_timing_profile' attribute pointing directly to a SOME/IP SDTimings instance defined in communication/someip/sd_config.flync.yaml, bypassing the abstract service interface layer.

scenarios.title: Detect and Reject Direct Reference from App to ExternalConnection
scenarios.description: This scenario tests the architectural isolation between the application layer (flync_4_app) and the network topology layer (flync_4_topology). It attempts to establish an illegitimate direct reference from a flync.model.flync_4_app.App instance to a flync.model.flync_4_topology.ExternalConnection instance, bypassing the standard service-to-port mapping abstractions.
scenarios.expected_result: The model loader throws a validation error during schema verification or cross-reference resolution, rejecting the configuration due to an invalid reference type. The system successfully maintains strict architectural isolation, preventing any direct dependency between flync_4_app.App and flync_4_topology.ExternalConnection.
scenarios.injected_fault: Modify the application YAML configuration defining a flync.model.flync_4_app.App to include a direct, hardcoded reference to a physical topology link defined as a flync.model.flync_4_topology.ExternalConnection (e.g., attempting to bind a ServiceConsumerReference directly to an 'ecu_port_to_ecu_port' connection ID).

scenarios.title: Validation Failure on Direct Reference from ServiceConsumerReference to TSN Stream
scenarios.description: This scenario tests the architectural boundary enforcement between the application layer and the TSN layer. A configuration is written where a ServiceConsumerReference (from flync_4_app) attempts to directly reference a Stream (from flync_4_tsn) as its transport mechanism, bypassing the standard service-to-transport mapping layer.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validation engine must fail, raising a schema validation or model consistency error. It must reject the configuration because ServiceConsumerReference has no defined relationship or attribute that allows direct coupling to a flync_4_tsn Stream class, maintaining strict isolation between the two submodels.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the application configuration file (e.g., apps/application1.flync.yaml), an illegitimate direct reference property 'tsn_stream_ref' is injected into a ServiceConsumerReference instance, explicitly pointing to the identifier of a TSN Stream instance ('stream_tsn_01') defined in the network's TSN configuration.

scenarios.title: Validation Failure on Direct Isolation Breach between CANBus and ECUPort
scenarios.description: Attempts to establish a direct, unauthorized architectural link between the flync_4_bus domain (using the CANBus configuration) and the flync_4_ecu domain (using the ECUPort class), which are designed to be completely isolated.
scenarios.expected_result: The model validator must throw a strict validation error during schema parsing, rejecting the configuration due to the illegal cross-domain references and enforcing the architectural boundary between flync_4_bus and flync_4_ecu.
scenarios.injected_fault: Injected a direct 'ecu_port_ref' property inside the CANBus configuration YAML pointing directly to an ECUPort class instance, and conversely added a direct 'bus_ref' inside the ECUPort configuration in ports.flync.yaml pointing to the CANBus class.

scenarios.title: Reject Illegitimate Direct Reference from CAN Bus to System Metadata
scenarios.description: Verify that the configuration parser rejects a CAN Bus configuration (representing the flync_4_bus domain) that attempts to establish a direct reference to the SystemMetadata class (from the flync_4_metadata domain). These two domains are architecturally isolated, meaning a physical bus configuration must never directly reference or depend on system-level metadata classes.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validator fails with a schema validation error, rejecting the configuration due to an illegitimate cross-domain reference and enforcing strict architectural isolation between flync_4_bus and flync_4_metadata.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the CAN bus configuration YAML file (communication/channels/can/can_main.flync.yaml), an unauthorized 'system_metadata_ref' field is injected directly under the bus definition, referencing the 'SystemMetadata' identifier to couple the physical bus directly to the system's global metadata.

scenarios.title: Direct Reference of E2EProfile inside CANBus Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify that the configuration parser rejects a CANBus configuration (from flync_4_bus) that contains a direct reference to an E2EProfile (from flync_4_safety). These two domains are architecturally isolated; safety properties must be configured at the PDU or Signal layer, never directly on the physical bus configuration.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validator fails with a schema validation error, rejecting the direct cross-domain reference between CANBus and E2EProfile and enforcing architectural isolation.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the communication/channels/can/engine_bus.flync.yaml file, a direct safety_profile_ref attribute is added to the CANBus class definition, pointing directly to an E2EProfile instance named 'E2E_Profile_Engine' from the flync_4_safety domain.

scenarios.title: Invalid Direct Reference of Firewall in CAN Bus Configuration
scenarios.description: This scenario tests the architectural isolation between flync_4_bus and flync_4_security. It attempts to define a direct relationship by referencing a flync.model.flync_4_security.Firewall class directly inside a CAN bus configuration (representing the flync_4_bus domain), which is an invalid cross-domain dependency.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration validation engine must fail with a strict schema validation error, rejecting the unexpected 'firewall' property in the bus configuration and preventing the isolation breach between the bus and security submodels.
scenarios.injected_fault: A CAN bus YAML configuration file under 'communication/channels/can/' is modified to include a direct 'firewall' property containing an inline definition of a flync.model.flync_4_security.Firewall with associated FirewallRule objects.

scenarios.title: Validation of Isolation Breach between CAN Bus and SOME/IP SD Timings
scenarios.description: This test scenario attempts to configure a physical CAN bus using the 'flync.model.flync_4_bus.CANBus' class that directly references a SOME/IP Service Discovery configuration 'flync.model.flync_4_someip.SDTimings' for its transmission timing, violating the strict architectural isolation between the physical bus domain and the application-layer SOME/IP service domain.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration parser and schema validator must reject the configuration, throwing a validation error because 'flync.model.flync_4_bus.CANBus' has no attribute or relation to 'flync.model.flync_4_someip.SDTimings', successfully maintaining domain isolation.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the CAN bus YAML configuration file under 'communication/channels/can/', a direct reference property 'sd_timing_ref' is injected into the CAN bus definition, pointing directly to an instance of 'flync.model.flync_4_someip.SDTimings' defined in 'communication/someip/sd_config.flync.yaml'.

scenarios.title: Invalid Direct Reference between ExternalConnection and CANBus
scenarios.description: This test scenario verifies that the system enforces strict architectural isolation between the 'flync_4_topology' and 'flync_4_bus' submodels. Specifically, it attempts to establish an illegitimate direct link between an ExternalConnection class instance (from flync_4_topology) and a CANBus class instance (from flync_4_bus).
scenarios.expected_result: The model loader must fail validation during the parsing phase, throwing a schema validation error that rejects the direct reference to a CANBus instance and enforces that all ExternalConnection instances must strictly connect ECU ports.
scenarios.injected_fault: An 'ExternalConnection' is authored in the 'ethernet_topology.flync.yaml' file where one of the connection endpoints directly references a 'CANBus' instance by name, instead of referencing a valid ECU port as required by the topology schema.

scenarios.title: Invalid Cross-Domain Reference between CAN Bus and TSN PTPConfig
scenarios.description: An illegitimate direct link is established where a CAN bus configuration in the 'flync_4_bus' submodel directly references a 'flync_4_tsn.PTPConfig' class instance to configure time synchronization, breaching the architectural isolation between the physical CAN bus domain and the TSN/gPTP domain.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration parser and validator must fail to validate, throwing a schema or reference error rejecting the cross-domain reference, confirming that 'flync_4_bus' and 'flync_4_tsn' remain strictly isolated.
scenarios.injected_fault: In the CAN bus YAML configuration file under 'communication/channels/can/', a 'ptp_config' key is injected that directly references a 'flync_4_tsn.PTPConfig' object to attempt gPTP synchronization on a CAN channel.

scenarios.title: Rejection of Direct Reference from FLYNCChannelConfig to SystemMetadata
scenarios.description: An invalid configuration is loaded where a communication channel defined in FLYNCChannelConfig (from flync_4_communication) directly references a SystemMetadata instance (from flync_4_metadata) via an unauthorized direct link, violating the strict architectural isolation between the communication and metadata domains.
scenarios.expected_result: The FLYNC configuration validator must reject the configuration, throwing a validation error indicating that FLYNCChannelConfig does not support metadata references and that cross-domain references between flync_4_communication and flync_4_metadata are strictly prohibited.
scenarios.injected_fault: Injected a direct 'metadata_reference' field pointing to a SystemMetadata block inside the YAML definition of a FLYNCChannelConfig under 'communication/channels/'.

scenarios.title: Cross-Domain Isolation Breach via Direct Reference from Communication Channel to Safety Config
scenarios.description: Attempts to establish an unauthorized direct dependency between the communication and safety domains by referencing a safety configuration class (FLYNCSafetyConfig) directly inside a communication channel configuration class (FLYNCChannelConfig). These two domains are architecturally isolated and must not reference each other.
scenarios.expected_result: The configuration compiler and schema validator must fail, rejecting the configuration with a validation error due to an unauthorized cross-domain reference and breach of architectural isolation boundaries.
scenarios.injected_fault: Injected a direct reference in the YAML configuration of a FLYNCChannelConfig instance under 'communication/channels/' that defines a 'safety_link' property pointing directly to a FLYNCSafetyConfig instance from the flync_4_safety submodel.
